steps.name: types-fixtures
steps.summary: Added src/types/{analysis,usage,api}.ts (AnalysisResult/Category/UsageStatus/SubscriptionStatus/route request-response types per ARCHITECTURE.md) and src/lib/fixtures/{analysisFixture,usageFixture}.ts (MOCK_ANALYSIS_RESULT + getLatestResult/setLatestResult/isProcessing/startProcessing/finishProcessing; getUsageStatus/hasRemainingAnalysis/consumeOneAnalysis/activateSubscription/cancelSubscription) with colocated *.test.ts; npm run build/lint/test all pass.

steps.name: analysis-routes
steps.summary: Added mock route handlers: POST /api/upload (400 invalid extension/>20MB, 200 + {jobId, fileName}), POST /api/analysis/start (maxDuration=300, 402 no remaining analyses, 409 already processing, 200 + AnalysisResult with usage decrement only on success via try/finally), GET /api/analysis/latest (404 no result, 200 + AnalysisResult), GET /api/usage (200 + UsageStatus); added __resetForTest() to analysisFixture/usageFixture for test isolation; colocated route.test.ts per route. npm run build/lint/test all pass.

steps.name: subscription-routes
steps.summary: Added POST /api/subscription/checkout (mock-activates subscription immediately in lieu of the Polar webhook flow, per this step's spec; simulateFailure body flag → 402 without state change, otherwise 200 + {subscriptionStatus:'active', currentPeriodEnd, billedAt}) and POST /api/subscription/cancel (400 if not active, else 200 + {subscriptionStatus:'cancel_scheduled', currentPeriodEnd} reusing the existing period end); colocated route.test.ts per route. npm run build/lint/test all pass.

steps.name: dashboard-integration
steps.summary: Replaced dashboard/page.tsx mock constants/setTimeout with real fetch calls: mount-time GET /api/usage + GET /api/analysis/latest (404 falls back to empty view), handleStartAnalysis now does POST /api/upload → POST /api/analysis/start (200 renders AnalysisResult + refetches usage, 402 routes to /billing, 409/other shows analysis-error with server message), result view renders AnalysisResult's Korean category/ratio/description/relatedTransactions/reason/note/text/basis fields; kept both demo error-preview buttons; added page.test.tsx covering the upload→analysis success render and the 402→/billing redirect. npm run build/lint/test all pass.
